component.name: Speechnotes
component.summary: Notes that read themselves aloud — and a book reader with the same voice

description.p: Speechnotes is a GTK4 notes app with a full text-to-speech stack and a book reader. Write in markdown, collect EPUBs and PDFs, and listen to any of it — everything runs on your machine, and your library is plain JSON you own.

ul.li: Markdown notes with notebooks, bookmarks, tags and full-text search
Read-along TTS: five engines (espeak-ng built in; Kokoro-82M, nano-edge-tts, Supertonic and Phonon download on demand)
Books: EPUB as published, PDF with OCR for scans, MOBI/AZW3, FB2, RTF, HTML, PowerPoint/ODP decks with a presenter window
BookDrop: phone-to-desktop transfer over the LAN (LocalSend-compatible)
Pomodoro with structured plans; four appearance schemes including E-Ink
Headless CLI for scripts and servers

description.p: First public alpha: notes, books, read-aloud speech with five engines, audiobooks, BookDrop, Pomodoro.
